operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a new booking (an appointment-style record). Provide the client, the booking date, and one or more services to book.

Each entry in `InvoiceItem` must reference an **active bookable service** — a product of type *Service* that has a duration configured and belongs to at least one category. A request whose services are not valid bookable services is rejected with `Please Enter Valid Service`.

The end time is calculated automatically from the services' durations, and the booking's staff and status are assigned automatically — you do not send them. Set `Invoice.convert` to `1` to immediately convert the new booking into an invoice within the same request; the response then also returns `invoice_id`.

The `.json` extension is optional and does not change the response.

client_id.description: Required. The id of an existing client the booking is for.

date.description: Required. The booking date in `dd/mm/yyyy` format.

start_time.description: Optional. Start time in 24-hour `HH:mm` format. Defaults to the start of the day when omitted.

description.description: Optional. Free-text note stored on the booking.

branch_id.description: Optional. The branch the booking belongs to. Defaults to the request's current branch.

convert.description: Optional. Set to `1` to also convert the created booking into an invoice in the same request; the response then includes `invoice_id`. Defaults to `0`.

InvoiceItem.description: The services to book. At least one is required and each must reference an active bookable service product.

product_id.description: Required. The id of a bookable service product (type *Service*, with a duration and a category).

200.description: The booking was created. Note this endpoint returns a `{code, message, id, appointment_id}` object (not the standard result envelope). When `Invoice.convert` was `1`, `invoice_id` is also returned; if the conversion failed, an `error` message is returned instead of `invoice_id`.

id.description: The id of the created booking.

appointment_id.description: The id of the appointment created for the booking.

invoice_id.description: Only present when `Invoice.convert` was `1` and conversion succeeded — the id of the invoice created from the booking.

400.description: The booking could not be created. Two cases: an invalid bookable service returns `{ code: 400, errors: "Please Enter Valid Service" }`; a save failure returns `{ code: 400, message: ... }`.

errors.description: Present when a booked service is not a valid bookable service.

message.description: Present when the booking itself could not be saved.
